technical.title: Creator & Lead Developer
technical.description: Actively building pro-mpt — a local-first Python CLI for archiving, searching, and analyzing personal AI prompt history across models (Claude, GPT-4, Gemini, etc.). Stack: Python 3.10+, Typer + Click CLI, Rich terminal UI, SQLite (local at ~/.pro-mpt/prompts.db), and the Anthropic API for Claude integration. Core features: multi-model prompt logging with rich metadata (app, domain, version, effectiveness rating), full-text search with multi-axis filtering, expertise trajectory analysis, ambient auto-import from Claude Code and Gemini CLI session files, interactive mode, and Markdown/JSON/CSV export. Architected around a strict local-first, no-lock-in philosophy — all data stays on-device. Roadmap includes GitHub integration, browser extension, smart prompt suggestions via LLM, and optional cloud sync.
